pitanje: Pronađi 10 skupova podataka i njihove naslove na engleskom jeziku.
sparql:
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

}

pitanje: Nađi skupove podataka o migracijama i izbjeglicama za Njemačku ili Francusku.
sparql:
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset ?title
WHERE {
  ?dataset a dcat:Dataset .
  ?dataset dct:title ?title .
  ?dataset dcat:theme <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/data-theme/SOCI> .
  ?dataset dct:spatial ?spatial .
  FILTER(
    ?spatial = <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/DEU> ||
    ?spatial = <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/FRA>
  )
  FILTER(LANG(?title) = "en")
  FILTER(
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?title)), "migration") ||

    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?title)), "asylum")
  )
}

pitanje: Prikaži mi skupove podataka o digitalnoj ekonomiji s izdavačima, objavljene između 2020. i 2023. sortirane po datumu.
sparql:
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset ?title ?publisherName ?issued
WHERE {
  ?dataset a dcat:Dataset .
  ?dataset dct:title ?title .
  ?dataset dct:issued ?issued .
  ?dataset dct:publisher ?publisher .
  ?publisher foaf:name ?publisherName .
  ?dataset dcat:theme ?theme .
  FILTER(
    ?theme = <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/data-theme/ECON> ||
    ?theme = <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/data-theme/TECH>
  )
  FILTER(LANG(?title) = "en")
  FILTER(
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?title)), "digital economy") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?title)), "digitalisation") ||
    CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?title)), "digitalization")
  )
  FILTER(?issued >= "2020-01-01"^^xsd:date && ?issued <= "2023-12-31"^^xsd:date)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?issued)
LIMIT 10

sparql:
